purpose: decide what question a future extractor should be asked, before designing or training that extractor. Development-only: prior work consumed the available fit data, so N2 may SELECT a candidate for a later confirmation order but may not make a confirmatory prediction claim and may not touch sealed or intact confirmation roles.

candidates.note: fixed to the targets already present in the accepted pretraining contract (candidate_full5_pcgrad_o2022 pretrain_manifest.json). NOTHING may be added after seeing N2 results.

forward_log_return.builder: agent_plugins.branch_pretraining.forward_log_return_targets — log(close[a+h]/close[a]) at anchor a = t-1 of sampled step t

barrier_hit.builder: agent_plugins.branch_pretraining.barrier_hit_labels — EXECUTABLE intrabar first-touch by HIGH/LOW, trailing_realized_vol_close_to_close lookback 64, upper_mult 2.0, lower_mult 2.0, epsilon 1e-8, adverse-first collision (contract verbatim); classes 0=upper,1=lower,2=censored

data_plane.source_contract: sealed candidate pretrain_manifest.json, verified via pretrained_branch_loader.verify_source before materialization
data_plane.sampling: identical to N1: stride 4 raw bars, max 2200 sampled steps, window 64, warmup per parsed contract; the input windows npz is rebuilt through the SAME collect_preprocessed_windows path and must reproduce the N1 input digest 0f31661c339556bc96f51d9e77514ac6b5d519a7a4ba64c00a8786d94ecfc884 for the 83-channel windows
data_plane.role_boundaries: no target label may cross a role boundary: label of anchor a consumes raw bars (a, a+h]; embargo below guarantees separation in sampled rows

role_geometry.derivation: role_geometry(n) exactly as the frozen N1 runner, with EMBARGO = 3 sampled rows (uniform across candidates: max over candidates of ceil(horizon_bars/stride) = ceil(12/4) = 3, stricter than or equal to every per-candidate requirement)
role_geometry.windows: four disjoint chronological score windows, all ending strictly before the first consumed screen-v2 monitor row (frontier = int(int(n*0.85)*0.82)); calibration precedes its score window with embargo; fit is the strict causal prefix
role_geometry.exact_ranges_published_in: run ledger role_geometry (source-index ranges per role per window) — republished verbatim in the results artifact
role_geometry.per_window_licenses: publish n, effective blocks, target variance (regression) or class support (classification) per window

realized_volatility: literal_trailing (past-only same-h trailing log realized vol at the anchor, NO fitted coefficient)
calibrated_ar1 (ridge on the single trailing feature; fit on fit role, lambda selected on calibration only)
baselines.strongest_baseline_rule: the strongest baseline of a family is the declared baseline with the LOWEST pooled primary loss over all score observations — a rule fixed here, not a post-hoc choice

primary_losses.forward_log_return: per-observation squared error on the log-return target
primary_losses.realized_volatility: QLIKE on variances: F = (max(exp(pred)-1e-8, 1e-8))^2, r2v = (max(exp(y)-1e-8, 1e-8))^2, qlike = r2v/F - log(r2v/F) - 1
primary_losses.barrier_hit: multiclass log loss, probabilities clipped at 1e-12

forward_log_return: directional accuracy (sign agreement, zero counts as miss)

primary_losses.pooling_prohibition: metrics from different target families are NEVER numerically pooled; every candidate is converted to within-family skill = 1 - loss_model/loss_baseline

2_target_history.forward_log_return: ridge on the last 12 raw per-bar log returns ending at the anchor (returns[a-11..a])
2_target_history.realized_volatility: ridge on the trailing same-h log realized vol at sampled-step lags 0,1,2,3
2_target_history.barrier_hit: multinomial logistic on the trailing barrier-scale vol (lookback 64) at sampled-step lags 0,1,2,3

3_causal_linear_summary.features: FIXED causal summary of the 83 preprocessed input channels over the trailing 64-bar observation window: per channel [last value, window mean, window std] = 249 features

models_cpu_only.hyperparameters: ridge lambda grid [1e-4,1e-3,1e-2,1e-1,1,10,100]; logistic C grid [0.01,0.1,1,10]; selected on CALIBRATION primary loss only; feature standardization uses FIT-role mean/std only; conditioning, selected regularization and coefficient norms recorded per unit so catastrophic linear failure is diagnosable
models_cpu_only.prohibited: no GRU, transformer, extractor or RL agent in N2 (order §5.3); temporal neural confirmation requires a later order

uncertainty_dependence_aware.statistic: mean per-observation primary-loss difference d_i = L_strongest_baseline(i) - L_model(i) over all score observations of the four windows
uncertainty_dependence_aware.method: circular block bootstrap, block length 6 sampled rows (>= embargo 3; ~216^(1/3)), B = 2000, RNG seed 505, blocks resampled WITHIN each score window (adjacent windows are never treated as independent replications; no cross-window t-test)
uncertainty_dependence_aware.p_value: one-sided p = (1 + #{bootstrap mean <= 0}) / (B + 1) against H1: mean difference > 0
uncertainty_dependence_aware.multiplicity: Holm step-down across ALL NINE candidates via agent_plugins.paired_inference.holm_adjust (the R3-repaired monotone implementation)

candidate_passes_iff: per-window skill > 0 against EVERY declared baseline of its family in EVERY score window
pooled skill against the strongest baseline >= 0.02 (materiality)

licenses hold: >= 8 effective blocks per window; barrier candidates additionally require classes 0 and 1 each >= 30 observations in EVERY score window and non-degenerate fit/cal labels; regression candidates require target variance > 0 per window
advance_rule.license_failure: a candidate with degenerate labels, inadequate class support or insufficient effective blocks is INCONCLUSIVE_CANDIDATE, never a winner and never silently dropped

verdicts.TARGET_CANDIDATE_FOUND: at least one candidate passes the full rule
verdicts.NO_TARGET_CANDIDATE_DEMONSTRATED: all complete candidates fail the rule
verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE: missing/failed units, inadequate effective support, discordant evidence, any unlicensed case, or any negative-control failure

advance_rule.selection_rule_max_two: among passers rank by MINIMUM per-window skill vs the strongest baseline (stability, not the largest raw score); ties broken by smaller Holm-adjusted p, then smaller horizon; select at most two; their neural confirmation is NOT begun automatically

negative_controls.never_eligible: controls diagnose the harness and are never candidates
negative_controls.future_leak_sentinel: per family at the mid horizon (ret_h6, vol_h6, bar_h6): the census linear model receives the TRUE target as its only feature (one-hot for classification). It must achieve pooled skill >= 0.5 vs the strongest baseline in every window — proving the harness detects leakage as unrealistically easy. Failure -> census INCONCLUSIVE
negative_controls.causally_shifted_target: per family at the mid horizon: model 3 trained against the target circularly time-shifted by +37 sampled rows (roles unchanged, marginal distribution preserved). It must NOT satisfy the advance rule. If it passes -> census INCONCLUSIVE

execution_bounds.device: CPU only, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; no GPU work authorized (order §7)
execution_bounds.heartbeat: minute-level status.json with completed/total units, throughput and ETA
execution_bounds.stop_file: STOP_CENSUS in the run root -> terminate-and-reap
execution_bounds.immutable_digests: input npz per family, source csv, sealed pretrain manifest+generation, code (census tool + experiment_runtime + branch_pretraining + temporal_information + paired_inference), and THIS predeclaration; re-verified at claim
execution_bounds.terminality: no retry of a terminal scientific result; infrastructure interruptions resume only through the same ledgered identity; aggregate recomputed from exact terminal unit records only

units.grain: one unit = (candidate-or-control, score window): all of that candidate's family models and baselines computed inside the unit
units.count: 9 candidates x 4 windows + 6 controls x 4 windows = 60
